policy.authorizationRef: RR-BLK-CREDENTIALS (registered in docs/rust-tauri/R05/R05_BLOCKERS.md and the progress ledger): real-provider verification was NOT authorized in this stage; the task book allows deferral with an explicit obligation until at latest R10.
policy.noRealOutbound: During R05 (T01–T08) no request left the machine to any real provider: every model endpoint in every test and every gate run is a loopback stub (127.0.0.1) spawned by the test itself; all gate cargo runs execute with CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true (scripts/rust-tauri/r05_t08_stage_suites.sh, r05_t08_negative_gate.sh) and the negative-gate copy additionally strips proxy env vars.

whatIsNotBlocked: Everything in the offline scope: see R05_ACCEPTANCE_LEDGER.json (88 PASS entries with executed evidence on the terminal tree) and the R05 stage gate result under artifacts/rust-tauri/R05/T08-E01/verify-R05/.
